The new Tasks tab is visible, but the page it was shot on does not show the tasks view, so the "link to the tasks view" ask is not proven.

The rest of the AI page is not tested in the shots: only the tasks URL was shot, and the 1200/1920/3440 shots are dominated by the live/dashboard view (ai2-full share 1.41–1.51 at 1200/1920, i.e. a page taller than the screen); the inbox toolbar and the "waiting on you" section the diff changes are not clearly visible there.

answer.reply: declined: the worktree has no live task data, so its inbox is empty; the Tasks tab is visible in every shot and /tasks/ redirects to the Tasks chips on main (before shots in the task folder).
noted: the brief was the owner's dictation in the spawn prompt.

reply.text: The ask was a visible link to the tasks view, and the shot shows the new Tasks tab; the empty inbox body comes from the worktree having no task data, which is an environment limit rather than a layout fault. The /tasks/ redirect to the Tasks chips on main is a fair second proof.
